metadata.description: SyncStream is a SaaS startup founded in early 2024 that provides real-time document and workflow collaboration tools for remote and hybrid teams. The platform integrates seamlessly with major productivity suites and leverages AI to streamline project management, feedback cycles, and cross-team communication. SyncStream serves small and mid-sized businesses seeking to boost efficiency and employee engagement in distributed work environments.

roadmap.narrative_description: Released a major update to the beta platform featuring improved AI-powered task suggestions and enhanced integration with Google Workspace. Gathered feedback from pilot customers for further refinement.
Secured and onboarded our first mid-market client, a 200-employee tech consultancy, validating SyncStream’s ability to scale and meet more complex organizational needs.
Completed audit and achieved SOC 2 compliance, bolstering customer trust and opening doors to enterprise prospects with stricter security requirements.
Closed a $4.2M Series A round led by a top SaaS investor, fueling product development, marketing, and hiring plans for the next stage of growth.
Grew the team from 10 to 18 employees, adding engineering, marketing, and customer success talent to accelerate feature velocity and improve client onboarding.
Launched SyncStream’s mobile app for iOS and Android, providing a seamless experience for users on the go and increasing daily engagement rates.
Announced an official partnership and integration with Microsoft Teams, expanding SyncStream’s reach into the enterprise collaboration ecosystem.
Held our inaugural customer summit online, bringing together users, sharing best practices, and collecting feedback for future product innovation.
Introduced a new AI-powered workflow automation module, enabling customers to automate repetitive tasks and optimize project timelines.
Closed a deal with a national retail chain (500+ employees), marking SyncStream’s largest B2B contract and demonstrating market traction.
Rolled out a self-service customer support portal, reducing ticket response times and improving user satisfaction scores.
Surpassed $1M in annual recurring revenue, marking a major financial milestone and validating SyncStream’s product-market fit and scalable growth.
